abstract: A rare metastatic lesion is presented in a 77-year-old black man. The primary disease was fulminating from the time of admission, and diagnosis was established by oral biopsies. The unusual features in this case, in addition to the rarity of the tumor, are the age and race of the patient, the peculiar metastases, and difficulty in identifying a primary site.
abstract_ja: 77歳の黒人男性に生じた、上顎歯肉への稀な転移性病変を報告する。原発性疾患は入院時から激烈な経過をたどり、診断は口腔生検によって確定された。本症例の特異な点は、腫瘍の希少性に加え、患者の年齢と人種、特異な転移形式、そして原発巣の同定が困難であったことである。
